chapters.title: One Cell, One Thread
chapters.blurb: A cell is a Durable Object: named, single-threaded, with its own SQLite. Requests interleave only at await; storage never does.

chapters.title: The Bucket Is the Coordinator
chapters.blurb: Ownership is one compare-and-swap on an owner record in the fleet bucket. No membership protocol, no failure detector, no consensus.

chapters.title: Durable Before Acknowledged
chapters.blurb: A write takes a durability ticket and waits at the output gate until its pages land in the bucket. The epoch in the prefix fences stale owners.

chapters.title: Sleep Cheap, Wake on Time
chapters.blurb: Idle cells hibernate to the bucket, and committed alarms mirror into minute-keyed wake entries, so no alarm is lost even when a node dies.

chapters.title: One Function Decides
chapters.blurb: Every behavioral decision flows through one pure function, on_event, driven by a single actor and verified by deterministic simulation and workerd conformance.
